description: This file defines the FileSystemMonitor class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides an interface for monitoring file system changes, with platform-specific implementations for Linux, Windows, and potentially other systems. The class includes mechanisms for registering and unregistering callbacks for file or directory changes, managing inotify watches on Linux, and handling directory change notifications on Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific implementation of a file system monitoring class, providing registration, unregistration, and event handling for file and directory changes.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback functions invoked upon file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Helper class managing a list of callbacks for a specific file or directory.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Worker
classes.description: Thread class used on Windows to handle asynchronous directory change notifications.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FileSystemMonitor.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor's file descriptor or handle is valid.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specified filename or directory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for a specified filename or directory.
